tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: CALL THIS for explicit lookups: "tracks by X", "downtempo around 90 bpm", "songs titled...". Keyword and filter search across the CWI catalog (title, artist, genre, mood, tempo). Use semantic_search instead if the user describes a feeling.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: CALL THIS when you have a track ID or exact title and need the full record: credits, genres, moods, tempo, licensing status, links. Usually follows a search.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user asks about an artist: "who is King Ahkeem", "what else has this artist made". Returns the artist profile and catalog.

tools.name: sync_search
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user needs music for film, TV, ads or games: "tense instrumental for a chase scene". Returns tracks suited to the scene with direct-clearance licensing info. To start a licensing conversation, follow with submit_sync_brief.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user describes music in plain words: "rainy night drive, nostalgic", "something that sounds like a heist". Returns catalog matches ranked by meaning rather than keywords.

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user wants the big picture: "how is the catalog organized", "what is Post-Trap Futurism", "how are these genres related". Returns the catalog's genre and relationship graph.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user asks about a specific release: tracklist, date, credits, background. Returns a fact packet for that release.

tools.name: get_radio
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user asks what is on the radio right now: "what is playing", "is Radio 365 live". Returns live Cumulative Radio 365 state and the current track.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user asks what is new: "any new music", "what is CWI up to", "latest news". Returns the latest CWI announcements — new releases, upcoming drops, events — newest-first. Filter by "releases", "news", or "events".

tools.name: get_featured
tools.description: CALL THIS when recommending music: "what should I listen to", "what is hot right now", "best tracks". Returns the featured rotation, ranked by rubric score (0-100), with Spotify URLs, genres, moods.

tools.name: get_up_next
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user asks what plays next on Radio 365: "what's coming up", "what's after this song". Returns the upcoming queue.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: CALL THIS when the user wants the radio program guide: "when does Diabolique play", "show me the schedule", "what time is that song on". findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_graph, get_featured, submit_for_airplay, get_requests, get_recommendations · Private data: get_track, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, pitch_for_playlist, rsvp · Public sink: get_graph, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, rsvp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_graph, get_featured, submit_for_airplay, get_requests, get_recommendations · Private data: get_track, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, pitch_for_playlist, rsvp · Public sink: get_graph, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, rsvp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the CWI placement catalog (That Boy Hi Hat + roster) by keywords. Same scored engine as GET /query: title matches weigh 3x, genre 2x, mood 1x. Returns top 5 tracks with Spotify URLs and matched terms." → after: "CALL THIS for explicit lookups: "tracks by X", "downtempo around 90 bpm", "songs titled...". Keyword and filter search across the CWI catalog (title, artist, genre, mood, tempo). Use semantic_search instead if the user describes a feeling."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
